text:
jia: kicked off a 2h soak in staging (mixed per-org + per-key quotas, routing policy = prefer-cheap-variant). quick summary: seeing short, repeated 429 spikes on a subset of API keys even though org-level quota shows headroom.

tom: can you share the traffic profile?

jia: payload — small clients, occasional spikes:
```json
{"clients":1200, "rps_per_client":0.4, "burst_per_client":60, "pattern":"poisson_with_periodic_spike"}
```
curl used to drive it:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/requests -H "Authorization: Bearer key-XXXX" -d @payload.json & done
```

samantha: saw the same. 429s cluster around TTL refill windows (every 60s). token-bucket for keys hits zero, but org token pool still has tokens. looks like enforcement is strictly per-key with no soft-sharing. also console telemetry only shows org-level RPS, so we missed the per-key spikes in the high-level graph.

kevin: that explains cascade: when a key gets 429s clients retry quickly -> routing policy kicks in and falls back to cheaper model variant -> that variant sees sudden QPS and either saturates or trips its own per-key limit. cascade.

maria: UX note — rollout/quotas page only surfaces per-org capacity and global latency. we should have a per-key heatmap (1m/5m avg) so support and SRE can triage faster.

jia: pasted some logs from the spot where it tripped: 
```
2026-03-17T14:07:12.341Z WARN token_bucket grant denied org=org-23 key=key-77 tokens=0 requested=12
2026-03-17T14:07:12.342Z INFO retry-scheduler scheduled delay=200ms key=key-77
2026-03-17T14:07:12.543Z ERROR model-router fallback-to-variant variant=rr-small reason=overloaded
```

tom: can we try burst-smoothing (leaky bucket refill smoothing / probabilistic soft-cap) in staging instead of hard 429? idea: allow brief overrun but apply probability-based throttling to reduce retry feedback.

kevin: agree. propose an experiment: add a per-key soft-cap window that does probabilistic drop once 1m avg > threshold and tune smooth_factor=0.2. also add small jitter to retry-scheduler to avoid synchronized retries.

jia: i opened a tiny PR for the enforcement switch (staging only): https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/enforce-soft-cap-staging (link). it exposes config: enforcement_mode=[hard,soft], smooth_factor=0.2, retry_jitter_ms=50-300.

soak-bot: job/soak-1782345678 finished — summary: run=2h, requests_total=3.5M, success=2.66M (76%), 429=840k (24%), tail_p95_latency_ms=1400, tail_p99_latency_ms=4200. artifacts: s3://soak-artifacts/staging/1782345678.zip

samantha: cool. telemetry gaps: we need per-key 1m and 5m moving averages, and a per-key token_bucket_utilization metric. without those the soft-cap tuning will be blind.

maria: UX backlog item created: CONSOLE-412 add key-level heatmap + link to recent soak artifacts.

kevin: i'll flip the enforcement_mode to soft for a canary subset (10% keys) tomorrow morning and add the Grafana panel for token_bucket_utilization. anyone object?

tom: :+1:

jia: one more gotcha — fallback-to-cheap-variant increases QPS to that model because it returns fewer tokens per request and clients may retry more often expecting shorter response times. turning off auto-fallback for the canary might give clearer signal.

kevin: noted. will disable fallback for canary.

samantha: action items:
- telemetry: add per-key 1m/5m avg + token_bucket_utilization (owner: samantha)
- enforcement experiment: soft-cap toggle + jittered retry (owner: kevin)
- UX: per-key heatmap + artifacts link (owner: maria)
- re-run soak with jittered spikes and no auto-fallback (owner: jia)
ETA: Wednesday EOD.

kevin: i'll create the staging feature flag and canary roll tomorrow AM.

jia: thanks all. dropping a couple more sample logs from the high-frequency window: 
```
2026-03-17T14:08:01.112Z INFO request recv key=key-77 latency_ms=28 tokens_consumed=8
2026-03-17T14:08:01.115Z WARN token_bucket grant denied key=key-77 available=0 requested=8
2026-03-17T14:08:01.316Z INFO retry attempt=1 key=key-77 backoff_ms=220
2026-03-17T14:08:01.540Z INFO request recv key=key-23 latency_ms=34 tokens_consumed=120
```

maria: ok i'll link the artifacts and update the rollout page mock tomorrow.

soak-bot: uploaded artifacts -> https://artifacts.internal/soak/1782345678.zip

tom: thanks, good notes.

jia: i'll schedule the next run after kevin toggles the flag.

kevin: assigned CONSOLE-412 and QUEST-233 for the experiment. i'll post canary results in this thread.

samantha: nice. :thumbsup:
